symptoms_en: Leaves have a vibrant, uniform green color and appear fully turgid.
No spots, blemishes, lesions, or insect damage visible on leaves, stems, or fruit.
Fruit grows normally with robust vines and sturdy stems.
symptoms_rw: Amababi afite ibara ry'icyatsi kibisi kiboneye kandi atoshye.
Nta mabara, uduheri, cyangwa imyenge igaragara ku mababi cyangwa ku mbuto.
Imbuto zikura neza kandi ruti n'amashami bikomeye.
diseases.cause_en: The plant is healthy and well-maintained with proper nutrients and moisture.
diseases.cause_rw: Igihingwa gifite ubuzima bwiza kandi cyitaweho neza.

chemical_en: No chemical treatment is required.
Continue routine monitoring for pests or diseases.
chemical_rw: Nta muti wa simikiza ukenewe kuri iki gihingwa.
Komeza gukurikirana isuku y'umurima.
organic_en: Continue watering properly and apply well-decomposed organic manure.
Maintain field hygiene and prune lower old leaves to increase aeration.
organic_rw: Komeza kuhira neza no gushyiramo ifumbire y'imborera ishyitse.
Bungabunga ibidukikije ukura ibyatsi bibi mu murima.

prevention_en: Keep regular scouting schedules for early detection of issues.
Ensure adequate watering and clean weeding around the crop base.
prevention_rw: Komeza kwita ku gihingwa buri gihe.
Genzura ko amazi ahagije kandi ko umurima usukurwa.
diseases.safety_warning_en: No chemical safety warning is required as no synthetic inputs are used.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Komeza gukora isuku rusange y'umurima nta muti uteye.

symptoms_en: Large, dark brown to black water-soaked spots on leaves and stems.
White moldy growth appears on the underside of leaves in humid conditions.
Fruits develop large, greasy brown lesions and rot rapidly.
symptoms_rw: Amabara manini y'ikigina cyangwa umukara ku mababi afite isura nk'aho yatwitswe n'amazi.
Urubobi rw'umweru rugaragara munsi y'ababi iyo hari ubuhehere bwinshi.
Imbuto zizaho amabara y'ikigina cyijimye kandi zikabora vuba.
diseases.cause_en: The fungus-like oomycete Phytophthora infestans, favored by cool, wet weather.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye (fungus) witwa Phytophthora infestans ukwirakwizwa n'ubuhehere bw'imvura n'imbeho.

chemical_en: Apply approved protective fungicides such as Mancozeb or systemic options like Metalaxyl.
Spray thoroughly covering both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe urimo Copper hydroxide cyangwa Mancozeb uyungururwa mu mazi.
Tera umuti ku mababi yose ukurikije amabwiriza yo ku gipfunyika.
organic_en: Spray copper-based organic formulations or fermented compost tea.
Instantly remove and destroy infected plant debris far from the field.
organic_rw: Gukoresha umuti ukozwe mu gikakarubamba cyangwa isabune y'amazi yoroheje.
Kuvanga amazi n'ifu y'ivu ry'amakara ukayatera ku gihingwa.

prevention_en: Avoid overhead watering and apply mulch to reduce soil splashing.
Space plants sufficiently to encourage fast drying of foliage.
prevention_rw: Kwirinda kuhira uminjira amazi ku mababi cyane cyane nimugoroba.
Gusiga umwanya uhagije hagati y'ibihingwa ngo umuyaga utambuke neza.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Observe a pre-harvest interval (PHI) of 7-14 days and wear protective clothing during application.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Guma hanze y'umurima nibura amasaha 24 nyuma yo gutera umuti wa simikiza.

symptoms_en: Brown spots with concentric rings ('target board' appearance) on older leaves.
Leaves turn yellow and drop off, starting from the bottom of the plant.
Dark, sunken spots may appear at the stem-end of the fruit.
symptoms_rw: Amabara y'ikigina afite imirongo y'uruziga nk'intego y'imyambi ku mababi ashaje.
Amababi arayonga, agahinduka umuhondo hanyuma agapfa akayunguruka.
Ibibanza by'umukara n'ikigina bishobora kugaragara no ku ruti hafi y'ubutaka.
diseases.cause_en: The fungus Alternaria solani, which survives in plant debris and soil.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye witwa Alternaria solani uba mu butaka kandi agakunda ubushyuhe n'ubuhehere.

chemical_en: Apply preventive fungicides containing Chlorothalonil or Mancozeb.
Begin application at the first sign of lower leaf spots.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe urwanya imihumye urimo Chlorothalonil cyangwa Mancozeb.
Gutangira gutera umuti igihe ubona ibimenyetso bya mbere bikiri bike.
organic_en: Prune lower leaves to reduce soil splash transmission.
Spray neem oil or baking soda solution mixed with horticultural soap.
organic_rw: Gukura amababi yafashwe ukayatwika cyangwa ukayahfukira kure y'umurima.
Gutera amazi avanze n'isabune ikozwe mu bimera (organic soap).

prevention_en: Practice crop rotation (avoid planting tomatoes or potatoes consecutively).
Stake plants and apply mulch to keep foliage clean.
prevention_rw: Gusimburanya ibihingwa mu murima buri gihe (ntugateremo inyanya cyangwa ibirayi bikurikirana).
Gushyiraho isaso (mulching) kugira ngo ubutaka bw'isuri butaruruka ku mababi.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Do not enter the field until sprays have completely dried. Keep children and animals away.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Amabwiriza y'umutekano agomba kubahirizwa: karaba intoki n'isabune kandi wambare agapfukamunwa.

symptoms_en: Rapid wilting of leaves and stems during hot days without prior yellowing.
Plants temporarily recover at night or in cool mornings but wilt again in daytime.
A cut stem placed in clear water releases a milky-white bacterial stream.
symptoms_rw: Igihe cy'izuba rirasiye, amababi n'amashami biraraba bikagwa bidahinduye ibara.
Kugaruka mu buzima bwiza nijoro cyangwa mu gitondo imbeho yaguye, ariko bikongera bikaraba ku zuba.
Iyo utenye uruti ukarushyira mu mazi akeye, hagaragaramo amazi y'umweru aremye (bacterial ooze).
diseases.cause_en: The soil-borne bacterium Ralstonia solanacearum, blocking water transport vessels.
diseases.cause_rw: Bagiteri yitwa Ralstonia solanacearum iba mu butaka igafunga inzira z'amazi mu gihingwa.

chemical_en: There is no effective chemical cure for infected plants.
Copper-based compounds can help limit secondary infection of neighboring crops.
chemical_rw: Nta muti wa simikiza uhari wo kuvura iyi ndwara iyo yamaze gufata igihingwa.
Imiti irimo Copper compounds ishobora gufasha gukumira ikwirakwira ku bindi bihingwa bitarafatwa.
organic_en: Uproot the entire wilted plant immediately and burn it away from the field.
Incorporate organic manure and practice bio-fumigation with brassica crops.
organic_rw: Kurimbura ibihingwa byose byarwaye ukayatwika kure y'umurima.
Gushyiramo ifumbire y'imborera ikize ku binyabuzima birwanya bagiteri.

prevention_en: Plant certified disease-free seedlings.
Avoid planting solanaceous crops in the same plot for 3-5 years.
prevention_rw: Gukoresha ingemwe zizewe zitanduye kandi ziturutse mu bigo byabugenewe.
Kudahinga inyanya mu murima wigeze kugaragaramo kirabiranya nibura mu myaka 3-5.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Always disinfect tools with bleach or alcohol after working near diseased fields to prevent cross-contamination.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Genzura ko ibikoresho byakoreshejwe mu murima ushyizemo ubutaka bw'abarwaye byasukuwe n'umuti wica udukoko.

symptoms_en: Leaves are glossy, uniformly green, and fully expanded.
Fruits are firm, vibrant, and free of any spots or soft patches.
Roots are strong and well-distributed in the soil.
symptoms_rw: Amababi akeye kandi atoshye neza.
Imbuto z'urusenda zirakomeye kandi zifite ibara risanzwe rishashagirana.
Nta bimera by'inyamujeri cyangwa ibibanza by'umukara byonona.
diseases.cause_en: Excellent cultural care, fertile soil, and optimal watering.
diseases.cause_rw: Kwita ku gihingwa neza n'ubutaka bukize ku ntungamubiri.

chemical_en: No chemical treatment required.
Continue preventive field inspections.
chemical_rw: Nta muti ukenewe.
Inama rusange: komeza ugenzure ubuhehere bw'umurima.
organic_en: Apply quality organic compost tea monthly.
Mulch around the base to preserve moisture and suppress weeds.
organic_rw: Komeza gushyiramo ifumbire ishyitse ya kijyambere.
Gukoresha isaso ngo ubutaka bugumane ubuhehere.

prevention_en: Keep the field clean and free of weeds.
Ensure adequate soil drainage to prevent root rot.
prevention_rw: Sukumura umurima buri gihe.
Genzura ko amazi adahama mu mizi y'urusenda.
diseases.safety_warning_en: No special synthetic safety warnings are necessary for healthy plants.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Nta kintu cy'ubumara gihari ku gihingwa kizima.

symptoms_en: Sunken, circular spots of black or brown color on pepper fruit.
Concentric rings with pinkish gelatinous spore masses in wet conditions.
Premature fruit drop and rapid shriveling of ripening peppers.
symptoms_rw: Ibibanza bifite isura nk'inyanja y'umukara cyangwa y'ikigina byibonera ku mbuto z'urusenda.
Imbuto zitangira kunyagana, gukata no kubora vuba ku gihingwa.
Ibibanza ku mababi n'uruti bishobora kugaragara.
diseases.cause_en: Colletotrichum fungi, heavily spreading in humid, warm climates.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye wo mu bwoko bwa Colletotrichum wandira mu gihe cy'imvura n'ubushyuhe.

chemical_en: Spray copper-based fungicides or Mancozeb.
Ensure chemical spray hits developing fruits directly.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe urwanya indwara z'imiye (Fungicide) urimo Copper oxychloride.
Saba inama y'umwaka ku bijyanye n'imikoreshereze y'imiti mu buhinzi.
organic_en: Spray extracts of garlic or neem seed oil.
Prune and safely burn infected peppers immediately.
organic_rw: Gutera umuti ukozwe mu gishishwa cy'umwaro cyangwa tungurusumu.
Kuramo no gusenya imbuto zose zafashwe kugira ngo indwara idakomeza.

prevention_en: Use certified pathogen-free seeds.
Avoid overhead irrigation to keep fruits dry.
prevention_rw: Gukoresha imbuto zizewe zidafite indwara.
Kwirinda kuhira uminjira amazi ku mababi no ku mbuto.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Respect the pre-harvest interval (PHI) and do not spray directly in windy weather.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Imiti yose igomba guterwa hapingwa akayaga kandi ukurikize intera y'igihe cyo gusarura.

symptoms_en: White, powdery fungal spots scattered on leaf undersides.
Upper leaf surfaces turn yellow, curl upwards, and eventually drop.
Severe defoliation results in reduced yield and sunburned fruits.
symptoms_rw: Urubobi rw'umweru rumeze nk'ifu runyanyagiye ku mababi, cyane cyane munsi yayo.
Amababi ahinduka umuhondo, agapfunyika hanyuma akayunguruka.
Ibihingwa bigwingira bikagabanya umusaruro cyane.
diseases.cause_en: The fungus Leveillula taurica, thrive in dry climates with high relative humidity.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye witwa Leveillula taurica wandira mu kirere cy'ubushyuhe n'ubuhehere buke mu gihe cy'izuba.

chemical_en: Apply wettable sulphur fungicides or systemic products containing Triadimefon.
Spray during evening hours to prevent sun scorch on treated leaves.
chemical_rw: Umuti urimo Sulfer (Sulphur-based fungicide) urwanya neza ifu y'umweru.
Gutera nimugoroba izuba ryamaze kurenga ngo umuti utatwika amababi.
organic_en: Spray fresh milk and water solution (ratio 1:9) which naturally acts as a fungicide.
Apply neem oil or baking soda solution with horticultural soap.
organic_rw: Gutera amazi avanze n'amata y'inshushyu (10% y'amata n'amazi).
Gukoresha umuti ukozwe mu isabune y'amazi n'amavuta ya neem.

prevention_en: Ensure adequate space between plants to facilitate good air movement.
Irrigate fields adequately to minimize crop stress.
prevention_rw: Gusiga intera ihagije hagati y'imirongo kugira ngo umucyo ugere ku mababi yose.
Kuhira umurima neza kugira ngo igihingwa kigire imbaraga zihagije.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Sulphur-based sprays can cause eye irritation; wear safety glasses and long gloves.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Imiti irimo Sulphur ishobora kuribwa mu maso; wambare ibirahure by'amaso igihe uyitera.

symptoms_en: Dark green, sturdy leaves spread out properly.
Stems are robust, standing upright, with no lesions or cankers.
Tubers are smooth, firm, and develop uniformly underground.
symptoms_rw: Amababi meza y'icyatsi kibisi agororotse neza.
Uruti rukomeye kandi nta bibanza by'umukara cyangwa igikuku kirimo.
Ibirayi biri munsi y'ubutaka bikura neza kandi bikomeye.
diseases.cause_en: Use of certified seed tubers, good soil fertility, and clean cultivation.
diseases.cause_rw: Gukoresha imbuto nziza y'ibirayi yatoranyijwe neza no kubitaho mu murima.

chemical_en: No chemical intervention is needed.
Inspect crops periodically for early blight or late blight signs.
chemical_rw: Nta muti ukenewe.
Inama rusange: genzura niba nta bibembe bitangiye kwirundanyiriza.
organic_en: Keep hilling (earthing up) the soil around stems to protect tubers from pests and diseases.
Incorporate organic compost during soil preparation.
organic_rw: Komeza gusasira no gukorera umurima isuku.
Gushyiramo ifumbire y'imborera ishyitse ku gihe cyo kubagara.

prevention_en: Always plant certified seed potatoes.
Practice deep crop rotation with non-solanaceous plants.
prevention_rw: Gukoresha imbuto yakorewe isuzuma.
Gusimburanya ibihingwa mu murima buri gihe.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Maintain standard field sanitation and hand wash after farm labor.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Genzura isuku n'umutekano w'imirimo yose yo mu murima.

symptoms_en: Water-soaked lesions on leaves, turning quickly to large brown-black dead spots.
White powdery mildew visible at the margin of the lesions on leaf undersides.
Tubers develop dry, reddish-brown rot and decay rapidly.
symptoms_rw: Amabara y'ikigina cyangwa umukara atangirira ku mutwe w'ababi hanyuma agakwirakwira vuba.
Urubobi rw'umweru nka kime munsi y'ababi iyo hari ubuhehere bukabije.
Ibirayi byo hasi birabora kandi bikagira impumuro mbi cyane.
diseases.cause_en: Phytophthora infestans, a devastating oomycete pathogen highly active in high humidity.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye Phytophthora infestans, indwara ikomeye cyane mu misozi miremire y'u Rwanda mu gihe cy'imvura.

chemical_en: Apply protective fungicides (Mancozeb) or curative systemic sprays (Metalaxyl).
Begin spraying preventively as soon as cool rainy conditions occur.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe urwanya imihumye urimo Metalaxyl cyangwa Mancozeb.
Banza utere umuti gukumira mbere y'uko imvura nyinshi itangira.
organic_en: Spray copper oxychloride or copper hydroxide organic products.
Destroy all infected vines and tubers immediately to restrict spore spread.
organic_rw: Gukoresha umuti ukozwe mu buvangeri bw'isabune, amavuta, n'amazi y'ivu ry'amakara.
Kurandura no gutwika ibihingwa byafashwe.

prevention_en: Select blight-resistant potato varieties.
Implement high and wide hilling to physically block spores from reaching tubers.
prevention_rw: Gutera imbuto zihanganira ikibembe cy'ibirayi.
Kubagara neza no gusongera ubutaka ku birayi (hilling) ngo umuhumye utagera ku birayi byo hasi.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Adhere to the safety intervals printed on pesticide containers. Wear a mask and boots.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Wambare ibikoresho bikurinda byose igihe utera umuti, kandi wirinde gukoresha imiti yarengeje igihe.

symptoms_en: Sudden wilting of foliage on warm afternoons, starting on branch tips.
Foliage becomes pale green or yellow, followed by complete plant death.
Squeezing cut tubers releases a thick white bacterial discharge from the vascular ring.
symptoms_rw: Ibihingwa biraraba bikoma hasi mu gihe cy'ubushyuhe, hanyuma bikabyuka nijoro.
Amababi agenda ahinduka umuhondo guhera hasi agana hejuru hanyuma igihingwa cyose kikuma.
Ibirayi bikase bisohora amazi y'umweru ameze nk'amashyira mu mizi (bacterial ooze).
diseases.cause_en: Ralstonia solanacearum bacterium, thriving inside host vascular systems.
diseases.cause_rw: Ralstonia solanacearum, bagiteri yangiza umuyoboro w'amazi n'intungamubiri mu kirayi.

chemical_en: No systemic chemical cures exist for bacterial wilt.
Apply protective copper fungicides to surrounding crops to reduce infection risk.
chemical_rw: Nta muti wa simikiza wemewe ushobora kuvura kirabiranya.
Gusa imiti irimo Copper compounds ishobora gukumira ibindi bihingwa bitarwara.
organic_en: Uproot and burn diseased plants. Do not dump them in compost.
Apply agricultural lime to the planting holes to adjust soil pH.
organic_rw: Rimbura vuba ukayatwika kure y'umurima ibirayi n'ibihingwa byose byafatanyije na byo.
Sukura neza ibikoresho byose ukoresha mu murima wogeye.

prevention_en: Utilize only disease-free seed tubers certified by local agricultural authorities (RAB).
Do not cultivate potatoes in fields known to harbor bacterial wilt for at least 4 years.
prevention_rw: Gukoresha imbuto nziza ituruka mu bigo byizerwa (nk'ingemwe za RAB).
Kwirinda gutera ibirayi mu murima wigeze kugaragaramo kirabiranya nibura imyaka 4.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Disinfect tools with 10% bleach after handling plants suspected of infection to prevent pathogen transfer.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Kirabiranya ishobora kwandira ku bindi bihingwa bitari ibirayi binyuze ku bikoresho bidapfuye; sukura neza amasuka.

symptoms_en: Leaves are large, leathery, and dark green with distinct veins.
Fruits are smooth or pebbled according to variety, showing no dark lesions.
Branches and main trunk are strong, clean, and crack-free.
symptoms_rw: Amababi manini y'icyatsi cyiza kandi ashinyitse neza.
Imbuto za avoka zifite isura nziza kandi nta mabara cyangwa ububore.
Uruti n'amashami bikomeye kandi nta bikomere birimo.
diseases.cause_en: Well-drained aerated soil, correct watering, and regular tree pruning.
diseases.cause_rw: Ubutaka bufite amazi n'umuyaga bihagije kandi buyeze neza.

chemical_en: No chemical treatment is required.
Maintain orchard floor cleanliness.
chemical_rw: Nta muti ukenewe.
Komeza gukurikirana isuku no gukata amashami ashaje.
organic_en: Apply thick organic mulch (wood chips or straw) around the tree base to retain moisture.
Drench with compost tea enriched with beneficial Trichoderma fungi.
organic_rw: Shyiramo ifumbire y'imborera ishyitse mu mizi.
Bungabunga ibidukikije ukoresha isaso mu mizi ngo amazi atanyerera.

prevention_en: Irrigate moderately; avocado trees hate waterlogged roots.
Prune dead or overlapping limbs to maximize sunlight penetration.
prevention_rw: Kuhira neza ariko utarindiriye ko amazi arenga mu mizi.
Gukata amashami ashaje kugira ngo umuyaga n'umucyo bitambuke.
diseases.safety_warning_en: No chemical safety warnings apply to untreated healthy avocado trees.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Nta burira bwihariye kuri avoka nzima.

symptoms_en: Leaves are pale green, small, wilted, and drop prematurely.
Dieback of upper branches starting from the tips.
Feeder roots are black, decaying, brittle, and absent in advanced stages.
symptoms_rw: Amababi ahinduka umuhondo, akagwingira, akaba mato kandi akayunguruka vuba.
Umutwe w'igiti cyangwa amashami ya ruguru atangira kuyonga agapfa (dieback).
Imizi itangira guhinduka umukara, ikabora kandi ikavunika vuba iyo uyigenzuye.
diseases.cause_en: The soil oomycete Phytophthora cinnamomi, spreading rapidly in waterlogged soils.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye witwa Phytophthora cinnamomi wandira mu butaka bufite amazi menshi adatemba.

chemical_en: Inject or drench tree trunks with Phosphorous acid (fosetyl-Al).
Consult a certified agronomist for appropriate injection equipment and dosage.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe urwanya imihumye urimo Phosphorous acid uterwa mu giti cyangwa mu mizi.
Baza umwubatsi w'agronome mbere yo gutera iyi miti ikomeye.
organic_en: Apply gypsum and organic mulch to raise soil calcium and discourage the pathogen.
Improve drainage immediately by digging trench diversions.
organic_rw: Gushyiraho ifumbire y'imborera nyinshi (mulch) ikize ku binyabuzima nka Trichoderma.
Kureka ubutaka bukuma mbere yo kuhira undi muzunguruko.

prevention_en: Plant only verified healthy container-grown trees.
Plant on raised mounds or ridges to promote natural drainage.
prevention_rw: Gukoresha ingemwe zasuzumwe kandi zidafite ubu burwayi.
Guhinga avoka mu butaka buyungurura amazi neza budafunga amazi.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) when handling and injecting fungicides into trunks.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Imiti ya simikiza igomba gukoreshwa hagendewe ku mabwiriza y'inzobere ngo itangiza ubutaka cyangwa ibimera.

symptoms_en: Small circular dark spots on fruits that expand into large, sunken black spots.
Flesh beneath spots decays and becomes dark brown and bitter.
Leaves display dead brown margins and dry patches.
symptoms_rw: Ibibanza by'umukara bishobora kugaragara ku mababi, ku ndabyo no ku mbuto.
Ku mbuto zikuze, haza amabara y'umukara afite isura y'uruziga rwinjiye imbere (sunken spots).
Umunyigo cyangwa umubore uza imbere muri avoka iyo uyishishuye.
diseases.cause_en: The fungus Colletotrichum gloeosporioides, which infects developing fruit during rainy spells.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye Colletotrichum gloeosporioides wandira ku mbuto igihe cy'imvura n'ubuhehere bw'ikirere.

chemical_en: Apply copper-based fungicides (Copper hydroxide) at regular intervals during fruit-set.
Keep a strict spraying schedule during continuous rainy periods.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe urimo Copper-based fungicide uza gufasha kurwanya indwara ku mbuto zikiri nto.
Gutera imiti mu bihe by'indabyo n'imbuto zikiri ntoya.
organic_en: Prune away dead amashami and leaves within the canopy to lower humidity.
Harvest avocados promptly once mature; do not let them overripen on the branch.
organic_rw: Gukata amashami arwaye ukayatwika ngo adakwirakwiza uburwayi.
Gutera amavuta ya neem cyangwa amata y'inshushyu avanze n'amazi.

prevention_en: Ensure maximum tree canopy aeration and sunlight access.
Handle fruits gently post-harvest; skin injuries invite spores.
prevention_rw: Gukorera igiti isuku no gukata amashami arwaye cyangwa ashaje.
Kusarura imbuto ku gihe kandi ukazitwara neza zitomeretse.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Wash all harvest equipment thoroughly. Avoid spraying copper chemicals close to direct harvest days.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Karaba neza intoki n'ibikoresho nyuma yo gukorera igiti cyarwaye kugira ngo utanduza ibindi bitararwara.

symptoms_en: Broad, hairy leaves with rich green color and upright growth.
Stems are robust, supporting violet-colored flowers and young fruits.
Skin of eggplants is smooth, glossy, deep purple or white, free of spots.
symptoms_rw: Amababi atoshye kandi afite isura y'icyatsi kibisi kiboneye.
Uruti rukomeye kandi rurimo indabyo z'umuhengeri.
Imbuto z'intoryi zirashashagirana neza kandi nta mabara.
diseases.cause_en: Proper crop management, organic soil fertilization, and dry foliage watering.
diseases.cause_rw: Kubungabunga ubutaka bukize ku ifumbire no kuhira ku gihe.

chemical_en: No chemical products required.
Monitor fields regularly for spider mites and fruit borers.
chemical_rw: Nta muti ukenewe.
Inama rusange: guma ugenzure udukoko buri gihe.
organic_en: Maintain soil nutrients by adding well-rotted organic manure.
Irrigate at soil level to prevent moisture buildup on leaves.
organic_rw: Komeza gukoresha ifumbire y'imborera neza.
Kuhira amazi mu mizi utaminjira ku mababi.

prevention_en: Remove weeds to eliminate alternative hosts for insect pests.
Prune old, lower leaves to boost light penetration.
prevention_rw: Kurwanya ibyatsi bibi mu murima.
Kwirinda kwangiza amashami igihe cy'isukura.
diseases.safety_warning_en: No chemical warnings are applicable for naturally grown healthy eggplants.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Nta kibazo cy'umutekano ku gihingwa kizima.

symptoms_en: Sudden wilting of foliage, often starting from one branch, without yellowing.
The entire plant collapses rapidly within days and dies.
Vascular ring of stems turns dark brown and produces bacterial ooze when cut.
symptoms_rw: Amababi amwe atangira kuraba akabora nta muhondo ubanje kugaragara.
Igihingwa cyose kiraraba bikabije mu minsi mike hanyuma kikuma bikabije.
Uwo uduce tw'imizi dukase, twerekana ibara ry'ikigina ryijimye n'amashyira y'umweru.
diseases.cause_en: Ralstonia solanacearum, soil bacterium invading through root wounds.
diseases.cause_rw: Ralstonia solanacearum, bagiteri iba mu butaka yinjirira mu bikomere by'imizi.

chemical_en: No systemic chemical treatment can cure bacterial wilt.
Copper oxychloride compounds may be sprayed to protect healthy neighboring fields.
chemical_rw: Nta muti uhari wo kuvura iyi ndwara iyo yamaze gufata intoryi.
Kugabanya ikwirakwira rishobora gukorwa no gutera imiti irimo Copper Compounds.
organic_en: Uproot and burn diseased plants instantly. Do not leave them in the field.
Apply agricultural lime to raise soil pH, which suppresses the bacterium.
organic_rw: Kurandura no gutwika cyangwa gufukira kure cyane ibihingwa byarwaye.
Kuzamura PH y'ubutaka ukoresha ishwara y'ubuhinzi.

prevention_en: Use certified disease-free transplants.
Rotate eggplants with non-host crops like cereals for 3-4 years.
prevention_rw: Gukoresha ingemwe zizewe zitanduye.
Gusimburanya ibihingwa mu murima buri gihe: wirinda gukurikiza inyanya, ibirayi cyangwa intoryi.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Apply agricultural lime according to standard guidelines to avoid nutrient imbalances.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Ishwara y'ubuhinzi igomba gushyirwamo ku gipimo cyemewe n'agronome ngo idahindura ubutaka.

symptoms_en: Fine yellow stippling or spots on leaves, leading to bronzing.
Delicate spider-like webbing beneath leaves and around growing tips.
Leaves dry out, turn brown, and drop off rapidly during hot dry spells.
symptoms_rw: Utubara tw'umuhondo twiza twuzuye ku mababi hanyuma akagwingira.
Urubobi rw'igitagangurirwa rurabengerana ku mababi n'imbuto.
Amababi ahinduka umukara cyangwa ikigina hanyuma akayunguruka vuba.
diseases.cause_en: Tiny spider mites (Tetranychus urticae) sucking plant sap, favored by hot, dry weather.
diseases.cause_rw: Udukoko duto cyane tw'ibitagangurirwa (Tetranychus urticae) dukunda ubushyuhe n'amapfa.

chemical_en: Apply approved acaricides (e.g. Abamectin).
Ensure thorough spray coverage of leaf undersides where mites hide.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe wica ibitagangurirwa (Acaricide) urimo Abamectin.
Gutera umuti neza munsi y'ababi kuko ari ho udukoko twihisha.
organic_en: Spray high-pressure water onto leaf undersides to dislodge mites physically.
Apply neem oil or insecticidal soap solution.
organic_rw: Kuhira amazi ku mababi afite imbaraga ngo uhungure udukoko.
Gutera umuti ukozwe mu buvangeri bw'urusenda, tungurusumu, n'isabune y'amazi.

prevention_en: Maintain proper irrigation as mites hate moist environments.
Control weeds and clean field edges to prevent mite migration.
prevention_rw: Komeza guhira umurima neza kuko udukoko tudakunda ubuhehere.
Kusukura umurima no gukuramo ibyatsi bibi.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Acaricides are highly toxic; strictly wear gloves and a respirator when spraying.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Imiti yica ibitagangurirwa ni ubumara bukomeye; wambare utugurumanza n'agapfukamunwa igihe uyitera.

symptoms_en: Leaves are clean, trifoliate, and bright green.
Stems are slender but strong, carrying pinkish-white flowers.
Bean pods are crisp, succulent, and uniform green with no lesions.
symptoms_rw: Amababi meza akeye y'icyatsi kibisi.
Uruti rukomeye kandi rufite indabyo zera.
Imigunzu y'ibishyimbo iratoshye kandi nta mabara y'ikigina.
diseases.cause_en: Proper land preparation, rich organic matter, and dry canopy management.
diseases.cause_rw: Imikorere myiza y'ubuhinzi n'ubutaka bufite ifumbire y'imborera n'imborera-simikiza.

chemical_en: No chemical treatments necessary.
Inspect regularly for aphids and bean rust.
chemical_rw: Nta muti ukenewe.
Komeza ugenzure ko ibishyimbo bitanyagwa n'imvura ngo byandure.
organic_en: Keep rows clean and weed-free.
Irrigate early in the morning so foliage dries quickly in the sun.
organic_rw: Komeza gukora isuku mu mirongo y'ibishyimbo.
Bungabunga ibidukikije ukura ibyatsi mu mirongo.

prevention_en: Water plants at the base (drip irrigation preferred).
Rotate beans with maize or sorghum.
prevention_rw: Kuhira ku gihe cyane cyane mu muzi.
Gusimburanya ibihingwa.
diseases.safety_warning_en: No special synthetic safety warnings apply to untreated healthy bean pods.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Nta burira ku buryo busanzwe.

symptoms_en: Small, reddish-brown (rust-colored) powdery pustules on leaf undersides.
Leaves show yellow spots on the upper side, directly opposite the pustules.
Severe infections cause leaves to yellow, dry, and fall off rapidly.
symptoms_rw: Uduheri duto tw'ibara ry'umuringa (oranje/ikigina) twuzuye ku mababi cyane cyane munsi yayo.
Utu duheri iyo udukozeho, dusiga ifu y'ikigina ku ntoki.
Amababi ahinduka umuhondo, akagana hasi hanyuma agapfa vuba.
diseases.cause_en: The fungus Uromyces appendiculatus, spreading rapidly in warm, damp weather.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye witwa Uromyces appendiculatus wandira cyane mu bihe by'ubuhehere n'ubushyuhe bukabije.

chemical_en: Apply systemic fungicides containing Tebuconazole or protective Mancozeb.
Begin spraying at the very first appearance of pustules on lower foliage.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe urwanya imihumye urimo Tebuconazole cyangwa Mancozeb.
Gutera ku mababi yose guhera igihe ubona utubanza twa mbere.
organic_en: Spray copper oxychloride or baking soda-soap mixture.
Collect and burn all crop residues immediately after harvest.
organic_rw: Gutera amazi avanze n'isabune ikozwe mu bimera n'ifu y'ivu ry'amakara.
Kurandura no gutwika amababi yafashwe kugira ngo uburwayi butaguka.

prevention_en: Avoid high plant densities to optimize airflow inside rows.
Select rust-resistant bean varieties.
prevention_rw: Kwirinda gutera ibishyimbo mu buryo bucucitse.
Kukoresha imbuto zizewe zidafite indwara kandi zihanganira rust.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Never spray chemicals onto wet leaves in rainy weather. Observe the pre-harvest interval.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Imiti ya simikiza igomba guterwa nyuma y'uko amazi y'ikime yakutse ku mababi, kandi wubahirize igihe cyo gusarura.

symptoms_en: Sunken brown spots with dark borders on bean pods, occasionally oozing pink spores.
Brick-red to dark brown discoloration along leaf veins on undersides.
Seedlings can develop black cankers on cotyledons and collapse.
symptoms_rw: Ibibanza by'umukara n'ikigina byinjira imbere (sunken spots) ku migunzu y'ibishyimbo.
Imirongo y'ibigina ku miyoboro y'amababi munsi y'ababi.
Ubusanzwe imbuto zo hasi zishobora no kugira ibibanza bikazana ububore.
diseases.cause_en: The fungus Colletotrichum lindemuthianum, favored by cool, wet weather.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye Colletotrichum lindemuthianum ukunda ikirere cy'imvura n'imbeho.

chemical_en: Apply carbendazim or copper oxychloride fungicides.
Spray during flowering and early pod development, especially during rain.
chemical_rw: Umuti urimo Carbendazim cyangwa Copper oxychloride uza gufasha kurwanya ubu burwayi.
Umuti ugomba guterwa mu gihe cy'indabyo no mu bihe by'imvura buri minsi 10-14.
organic_en: Spray neem seed kernel extract or diluted garlic tea.
Never walk through or cultivate bean fields when foliage is wet.
organic_rw: Gukoresha umuti w'amavuta ya neem cyangwa tungurusumu yavanzwe n'amazi.
Kwirinda gukora mu gihingwa mu gihe cy'imvura cyangwa ubuhehere bwinshi.

prevention_en: Use certified seeds. Avoid saving seeds from anthracnose-infected harvests.
Rotate out of legumes for at least 2-3 years.
prevention_rw: Kwirinda gukoresha imbuto zasaruwe ku bihingwa byigeze kurwara antarakinose.
Gusimburanya ibihingwa mu murima buri myaka 2-3.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Strictly follow personal protective measures when using synthetic fungicides.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Ntiwinjire mu murima gutera umuti utambaye ibikoresho by'umutekano birimo agapfukamunwa.

symptoms_en: Leaves are thick, waxy, and uniformly spread out.
The cabbage head is firming up nicely, clean, and free of spots.
No insect feeding holes or slimy rot on any parts.
symptoms_rw: Amababi meza akeye agororotse neza.
Umutiriko w'ishu urimo kwipfuka neza kandi nta bimera by'umukara birimo.
Nta myenge y'udukoko cyangwa uduheri turwaza igihingwa.
diseases.cause_en: Consistent sanitation, optimal organic matter, and proper spacing.
diseases.cause_rw: Isuku y'umurima n'ifumbire ihagije y'imborera ishyitse.

chemical_en: No chemical treatments required.
Regularly inspect outer leaves for diamondback moth larvae.
chemical_rw: Nta muti ukenewe.
Komeza ugenzure ibyatsi bibi n'udukoko ku mababi.
organic_en: Water cabbage at root level to prevent moisture accumulation.
Keep borders cleared of cruciferous weeds.
organic_rw: Komeza kuhira amazi mu mizi ariko utazana ubuhehere bukabije.
Bungabunga ibidukikije ukura ibyatsi ku nkengero z'amashu.

prevention_en: Maintain rigorous field sanitation and tools disinfection.
Implement a 3-year crop rotation schedule.
prevention_rw: Isuku rusange y'umurima n'ibikoresho.
Gusimburanya ibihingwa.
diseases.safety_warning_en: No synthetic chemical safety warnings are necessary for healthy cabbages.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Nta burira.

symptoms_en: V-shaped yellow lesions starting on leaf margins, pointing inward.
Veins in affected areas turn distinctively black.
Cabbage head undergoes a dry, dark, foul-smelling rot.
symptoms_rw: Amabara y'umuhondo afite isura nk'inyuguti ya 'V' ku nkengero z'amababi.
Imiyoboro y'amababi ihinduka umukara (black veins) igihe igihingwa kigenda gishya.
Umutiriko w'ishu urabora kandi ugatunguka amazi anuka nabi cyane.
diseases.cause_en: The bacterium Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris, spread by splashing rain and contaminated tools.
diseases.cause_rw: Bagiteri Xanthomonas campestris pv. campestris, indwara ikwirakwizwa n'imvura n'imashini cyangwa ibikoresho bidapfuye.

chemical_en: No direct chemical cure exists for bacterial black rot.
Apply copper hydroxide sprays to protect uninfected plants in the vicinity.
chemical_rw: Nta muti wemewe uhamye urwanya bagiteri mu mashu.
Gutera imiti irimo Copper hydroxide bishobora gukumira ibindi bihingwa bitanduye.
organic_en: Uproot and burn diseased plants. Do not compost.
Sanitize farm tools immediately after working on infected plots.
organic_rw: Kurandura no gutwika amashu arwaye kure y'umurima.
Isuku ikomeye y'ibikoresho byose ukoresha mu buhinzi.

prevention_en: Use certified seeds treated with hot water before sowing.
Practice a strict crop rotation of at least 3 years.
prevention_rw: Gukoresha imbuto zizewe kandi zasukuwe mu mazi ashyushye mbere yo gutera.
Kusimburanya ibihingwa mu murima nibura mu myaka 3.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Copper compounds are highly toxic to aquatic life; avoid spraying near open water sources.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Copper compounds ni ubumara bw'amazi; wirinda ko umuti ugwa mu masomo cyangwa mu masoko y'amazi.

symptoms_en: Numerous small feeding holes on leaves, creating a 'windowpane' look.
Tiny light-green caterpillars on leaf undersides that wriggle when disturbed.
Damage to the developing cabbage head, ruining marketability.
symptoms_rw: Imyenge myinshi ku mababi bituma amababi amera nk'inzugi z'amadirishya (windowpane damage).
Uducurama duto cyane tw'icyatsi kibisi munsi y'ababi dushobora kwihunza iyo udukozeho.
Kwangirika k'umutiriko w'ishu bikagabanya cyane umusaruro.
diseases.cause_en: Diamondback moth caterpillars (Plutella xylostella) aggressively consuming brassica leaves.
diseases.cause_rw: Udukoko tw'inyamujeri (Plutella xylostella) turya amababi y'amashu yose.

chemical_en: Apply insecticide sprays containing Profenofos or Lambda-cyhalothrin.
Rotate chemical groups regularly to prevent the pest from building rapid resistance.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe wica udukoko (Insecticide) urimo Profenofos cyangwa Lambda-cyhalothrin.
Baza agronome kuko utu dukoko tugira ubudahangarwa vuba ku miti myinshi.
organic_en: Spray neem oil extracts or insecticidal soaps.
Apply Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) microbial bio-insecticides.
organic_rw: Gutera umuti ukozwe mu mavuta ya Neem (Neem oil) wica uducurama.
Gutera umuti w'ikinyabuzima witwa Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) urwanya utu dukoko ku buryo bwa kinyabuzima.

prevention_en: Plant mustard or radishes as trap crops on borders.
Conserve natural predators such as parasitic wasps.
prevention_rw: Gukoresha ibihingwa bikurura udukoko (trap crops) nk'isinapi (mustard) ku nkengero z'umurima.
Kubungabunga udukoko nka wasp (parasitoids) turya nyamujeri.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Spray only in the late evening to protect honeybees and beneficial insect predators.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Imiti ya simikiza igomba guterwa nyuma y'izuba kurenga kugira ngo idahungabanya inzuki na parasitoids z'inyamujeri.

symptoms_en: Erect, tubular leaves of a deep bluish-green color.
Bulb swelling naturally in soil with a clean surface.
No signs of discolored blotches or powdery lesions.
symptoms_rw: Amababi atoroshye y'icyatsi kibisi n'ibitunguru birimo kwisunga neza hasi.
Nta mabara y'ikirungurira cyangwa ifu ku mababi.
Umutiriko n'imizi bikura neza kandi nta bibanza.
diseases.cause_en: Standard weed control, moderate watering, and clean well-drained soil.
diseases.cause_rw: Kubungabunga umurima no gukoresha ubutaka busukuye.

chemical_en: No chemical treatment required.
Scout weekly for thrips or purple blotch spots.
chemical_rw: Nta muti ukenewe.
Komeza gukurikirana ibimenyetso by'udukoko twa tiripsi.
organic_en: Ensure deep, light, aerated soil bed.
Irrigate sparingly to avoid fungal multiplication.
organic_rw: Komeza guhira mu buryo bushyize mu gaciro.
Bungabunga ibidukikije ukoresha isaso.

prevention_en: Practice clean weeding in and around beds.
Control excessive moisture levels.
prevention_rw: Sukumura umurima.
Genzura ubuhehere bw'umurima.
diseases.safety_warning_en: No chemical safety precautions are needed for untreated healthy onions.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Nta burira busabwa.

symptoms_en: Small water-soaked leaf spots, expanding into purple lesions with yellow borders.
Lesions may girdle leaves, causing them to collapse and dry up.
Bulbs rot starting at the neck, turning spongy and dark brown.
symptoms_rw: Ibibanza bito by'amazi ku mababi hanyuma bikaguka bikazana isura y'umuhengeri cyangwa umukara.
Ibibanza bikomeza kuba binini bigahinduka umurezi cyangwa umukara ku nkengero z'ibitunguru.
Amababi agenda avunika ahuye n'umuyaga hanyuma akuma vuba.
diseases.cause_en: The fungus Alternaria porri, highly favored by warmth and wet foliage.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye Alternaria porri, indwara ikunda ubuhehere bwinshi n'ubushyuhe.

chemical_en: Spray fungicides containing Difenoconazole or Mancozeb.
Apply chemicals at the onset of rains to prevent severe infection.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe urwanya imihumye urimo Difenoconazole cyangwa Mancozeb.
Banza utere umuti igihe cy'imvura n'ubuhehere bwinshi nk'ingamba zo gukumira.
organic_en: Spray garlic extract and baking soda dissolved in water.
Uproot, dry, and safely burn heavily infected foliage.
organic_rw: Gutera amazi arimo tungurusumu na baking soda (ifu yo guteka ikora nka organic fungicide).
Gusenya no gutwika amababi yose yafashwe kure y'umurima.

prevention_en: Ensure wide plant spacing to dry leaves quickly.
Practice crop rotation; avoid cultivating onions or garlic consecutively.
prevention_rw: Gusiga intera ihagije hagati y'imirongo ngo ibitunguru byume vuba nyuma y'imvura.
Gusimburanya ibihingwa mu murima, ntugateremo ibitunguru n'ikirungurira bikurikirana.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Mancozeb carries safety risks; observe pre-harvest intervals strictly (minimum 7-14 days).
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Mancozeb ni ubumara bushobora kwangiza ubutaka n'amazi; wubahirize amabwiriza yose yo ku gipfunyika.

symptoms_en: Silvery patches or streaks on leaves caused by sucking damage.
Leaf tips turn brown, wither, and leaves twist or curl.
Clusters of tiny, yellow or black insects active inside leaf bases.
symptoms_rw: Amabara y'umweru cyangwa ifu y'umuringa (silver patches) ku mababi y'ibitunguru.
Amababi atangira kugwingira, kwihina, no guhinduka umukara cyangwa ikigina mu mitwe.
Udukoko duto cyane twinshi tw'umuhondo cyangwa umukara tugenda ku mababi.
diseases.cause_en: Thrips tabaci insects sucking plant juices, active in hot, dry weather.
diseases.cause_rw: Udukoko duto (Thrips tabaci) tunywa amazi y'ibimera bituma amababi yuma.

chemical_en: Spray approved insecticides (Deltamethrin or Imidacloprid).
Aim nozzle deep into the neck area where thrips shelter.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe wica udukoko urimo Deltamethrin cyangwa Imidacloprid.
Gutera umuti ugana munsi y'ababi kuko ari ho utu dukoko twihisha.
organic_en: Irrigate using overhead sprinklers to mechanically wash pests away.
Apply neem oil or insecticidal soap sprays.
organic_rw: Kuhira umurima ukoresha uburyo bwo kuminjira amazi (sprinkler irrigation) ngo uhungure udukoko.
Gutera umuti ukozwe mu isabune y'amazi n'amavuta ya neem.

prevention_en: Perform clean weeding. Eliminate surrounding grass borders.
Do not plant onions adjacent to legume fields where thrips multiply.
prevention_rw: Isuku y'umurima no gukuramo amashami n'ibyatsi bibi ku nkengero.
Kwirinda gutera ibitunguru hafi y'imirima y'ibishyimbo kuko tiripsi zandura vuba.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Do not apply Imidacloprid on flowering crops to protect local bee populations.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Imidacloprid ni ubumara bw'inzuki; wirinda kuyitera mu gihe cy'indabyo cyangwa ku manywa y'ihangu.

symptoms_en: Large, coarse leaves with deep green color.
Cucumbers are firm, straight, and show uniform dark green skin.
No powdery or moldy growths on any vines.
symptoms_rw: Amababi manini atoshye y'icyatsi kibisi kiboneye.
Imbuto za concombre zirashinyitse kandi nta mabara y'ikigina.
Nta rubobi cyangwa ifu y'umweru iri ku mababi.
diseases.cause_en: Clean field conditions, stable soil moisture, and drip watering.
diseases.cause_rw: Isuku y'umurima n'ubuhehere buhuye neza mu mizi.

chemical_en: No chemical treatment required.
Scout leaves for fungal spots regularly.
chemical_rw: Nta muti ukenewe.
Komeza gukurikirana imikurire.
organic_en: Apply rich compost manure to soil bases.
Irrigate roots directly using drip pipes.
organic_rw: Komeza gukoresha ifumbire y'imborera ishyitse.
Kuhira amazi mu mizi ukoresha uburyo bwa drip irrigation.

prevention_en: Use clean mulch beneath the vines.
Practice deep crop rotation.
prevention_rw: Isaso isukuye munsi y'igihingwa.
Gusimburanya ibihingwa.
diseases.safety_warning_en: No synthetic chemical safety warnings are applicable for healthy cucumbers.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Nta burira rusange.

symptoms_en: Angular yellow spots on upper leaf surfaces bounded by leaf veins.
Greyish-purple moldy fuzz on leaf undersides in high humidity.
Leaves dry up, turn brown, and curl upwards rapidly.
symptoms_rw: Amabara y'umuhondo afite isura nk'imfuruka (angular spots) ku mababi ya ruguru.
Urubobi rw'umweru cyangwa urw'imvi munsi y'ababi iyo hari ubuhehere.
Amababi ahinduka umukara cyangwa ikigina vuba hanyuma akayunguruka.
diseases.cause_en: Pseudoperonospora cubensis oomycete, thriving in high moisture and morning dews.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye Pseudoperonospora cubensis ukunda cyane ubuhehere bwinshi n'ikime cy'igitondo.

chemical_en: Apply protective fungicides containing Copper oxychloride or systemic Metalaxyl.
Begin spray treatments preventively before rainy weather.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe urwanya imihumye urimo Metalaxyl cyangwa Copper oxychloride.
Gutangira gutera umuti igihe cy'imvura mbere y'uko ibimenyetso bikara.
organic_en: Spray aloe vera solution or fresh milk-water mixture.
Prune and destroy heavily infected lower leaves.
organic_rw: Gutera umuti ukozwe mu gikakarubamba cyangwa amata y'inshushyu avanze n'amazi.
Kurandura no gutwika amababi yafashwe guhera hasi.

prevention_en: Use drip irrigation to keep foliage dry.
Provide sufficient spacing to optimize crop ventilation.
prevention_rw: Kuhira ubutaka bwonyine (drip) kwirinda ko amababi yandura amazi.
Gusiga intera ihagije hagati y'ibihingwa ngo umuyaga n'umucyo bitambuke neza.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Copper compounds are toxic; do not re-enter fields for 12 hours after spraying.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Copper compounds ni ubumara; guma hanze y'umurima nibura amasaha 12 nyuma yo gutera umuti.

symptoms_en: White powdery spots spreading across leaf surfaces, stems, and fruits.
Leaves turn yellow, become brittle, and drop off prematurely.
Fruit size is reduced and taste becomes bitter.
symptoms_rw: Urubobi rw'umweru runyanyagiye ku mababi, ku ruti n'imbuto nka kime.
Amababi ahinduka umuhondo, agapfunyika hanyuma akayunguruka.
Imbuto zigwingira kandi zikagabanya uburyohe.
diseases.cause_en: The fungus Podosphaera xanthii, spreading in dry, warm climates following rains.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye Podosphaera xanthii wandira mu gihe cy'ubushyuhe bukabije bukurikira igihe cy'imvura.

chemical_en: Apply Sulphur-based fungicides or systemic options like Triadimefon.
Spray during evening hours to avoid sulphur sun scorch.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe urwanya imihumye urimo Sulphur cyangwa Triadimefon.
Gutera nimugoroba izuba ryarenze kuko Sulphur ishobora kurandura amababi ku zuba.
organic_en: Spray baking soda (5g per liter) mixed with mild liquid soap.
Prune to increase light exposure within foliage.
organic_rw: Gutera baking soda (gramu 5 ku litiro y'amazi) ivanze n'isabune y'amazi yoroheje.
Kuzamura umucyo ugera ku gihingwa.

prevention_en: Thoroughly prune dense crop areas.
Plant powdery mildew-resistant cucumber seed cultivars.
prevention_rw: Gukata amashami n'ababi bicucitse cyane.
Gukoresha imbuto zihanganira ifu y'umweru.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Wear appropriate protective equipment during application. Sulphur irritates eyes.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Sulphur ishobora kwangiza mu maso; wambare ibikoresho by'umutekano bikurinda igihe yo gutera.

symptoms_en: Bright green, lush, and upright foliage.
Root is well-formed, thick, smooth, and orange beneath the soil.
No rot, dry spots, or leaf blight lesions.
symptoms_rw: Amababi atoshye y'icyatsi kibisi kiboneye kandi agororotse neza.
Umudugudu cyangwa umuzi wa karoti uri hasi ukura neza nta mabara.
Nta mubore cyangwa kubora ku mizi cyangwa ku ruti rugufi.
diseases.cause_en: Light, loose, well-aerated soil beds and clean tillage practices.
diseases.cause_rw: Ubutaka buyungururwa neza n'isuku ikomeye y'umurima.

chemical_en: No chemical treatment is required.
Scout for early leaf spots.
chemical_rw: Nta muti ukenewe.
Komeza gukurikirana isuku y'umurima.
organic_en: Maintain moderate watering.
Keep fields weeded regularly.
organic_rw: Komeza guhira mu buryo bushyize mu gaciro.
Bungabunga ibidukikije ukura ibyatsi bibi.

Igihingwa gishobora gukurwa mu butaka bitaruhije kubera kubora kw'imizi.
Inanasi n'imizi bifite impumuro mbi cyane.
diseases.cause_en: Phytophthora cinnamomi oomycete, multiplying in heavy, waterlogged soils.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye Phytophthora cinnamomi wandira mu butaka bufite amazi menshi adatemba.

chemical_en: Apply preventive metalaxyl or phosphorous acid drenches.
Consult an agronomist before attempting chemical trunk injections.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe urwanya imihumye urimo Phosphorous acid uterwa mu mizi.
Baza umwubatsi w'agronome mbere yo gutera iyi miti ikomeye.
organic_en: Drench soil bases with Trichoderma-enriched compost solutions.
Improve block drainage systems immediately to stop waterlogging.
organic_rw: Gushyiraho ifumbire y'imborera nyinshi (mulch) ikize ku binyabuzima nka Trichoderma.
Kereza ubutaka bukuma mbere yo kuhira undi muzunguruko.

prevention_en: Select certified disease-free slips or suckers.
Plant pineapples on high, raised ridges to secure natural drainage.

Guhinga inanasi mu butaka buyungurura amazi neza budafunga amazi.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) when handling chemical fungicides.

Strong branches with smooth bark, no signs of oozing gum.

diseases.cause_en: Clean canopy pruning, optimal soil drainage, and clean orchard floors.

Apply organic manure around tree driplines.
organic_rw: Komeza gukoresha ifumbire y'imborera ishyitse.
Kuhira amazi mu mizi ukoresha uburyo bwa drip irrigation.

Avoid overwatering established mango trees.

symptoms_en: Dark brown to black circular lesions on leaves, blossoms, and fruits.
Sunken black lesions develop on ripe mangoes, causing pulp rot.
Foliage spots dry up and drop out, creating 'shot-hole' defects.
symptoms_rw: Ibibanza by'umukara bishobora kugaragara ku mababi, ku ndabyo no ku mbuto.
Ku mbuto zikuze, haza amabara y'umukara afite isura y'uruziga rwinjiye imbere (sunken spots).
Umunyigo cyangwa umubore uza imbere mu myembe.
diseases.cause_en: Colletotrichum gloeosporioides fungus, easily activated by rainfall during flowering.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye Colletotrichum gloeosporioides wandira ku mbuto igihe cy'imvura n'ubuhehere bw'ikirere.

chemical_en: Apply copper-based protective fungicides (Copper hydroxide) during flowering.
Begin spraying before flower buds open to secure blossom safety.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe urimo Copper-based fungicide uza gufasha kurwanya indwara.
Gutera imiti mu bihe by'indabyo n'imbuto zikiri ntoya.
organic_en: Prune out dead shoots and infected branches to lower relative humidity.
Harvest mangoes as soon as they reach maturity; avoid tree overripening.
organic_rw: Gukata amashami arwaye ukayatwika ngo adakwirakwiza uburwayi.
Gutera amavuta ya neem cyangwa amata y'inshushyu avanze n'amazi.

prevention_en: Optimize sunlight entry by keeping canopy well-ventilated.
Minimize mechanical skin damages during harvesting.
prevention_rw: Gukorera igiti isuku no gukata amashami arwaye cyangwa ashaje.
Kusarura imbuto ku gihe kandi ukazitwara neza zitomeretse.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Thoroughly wash hands and harvesting implements after pruning infected canopies.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Karaba neza intoki n'ibikoresho nyuma yo gukorera igiti cyarwaye kugira ngo utanduza ibindi bitararwara.

symptoms_en: Huge, broad leaves of a solid green color, standing tall.
Main pseudo-stem is clean, robust, and supports heavy green banana bunches.
No dry, scorched yellow margins on foliage.
symptoms_rw: Amababi manini y'icyatsi kibisi kiboneye kandi agororotse neza.
Umutiriko w'ibitoki urimo gukura neza kandi nta bimera by'umukara birimo.
Nta myenge y'udukoko cyangwa uduheri turwaza igihingwa.
diseases.cause_en: Proper weeding, clean pruning of dry leaves, and correct mat management.
diseases.cause_rw: Isuku y'umurima n'ifumbire ihagije y'imborera ishyitse.

chemical_en: No chemical treatment is required.
Regularly inspect banana mats for BXW symptoms.
chemical_rw: Nta muti ukenewe.
Komeza ugenzure ibyatsi bibi n'udukoko ku mababi.
organic_en: Add thick organic mulch (banana trash or grass) around mats.
Keep sucker population to 3 per mat (mother, daughter, granddaughter).
organic_rw: Komeza kuhira amazi mu mizi ariko utazana ubuhehere bukabije.
Bungabunga ibidukikije ukura ibyatsi ku nkengero.

prevention_en: Always disinfect pruning knives with fire or household bleach between plants.
Control weeds to reduce competing organisms.
prevention_rw: Isuku rusange y'umurima n'ibikoresho.
Gusimburanya ibihingwa.
diseases.safety_warning_en: No special chemical safety warnings are applicable for healthy bananas.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Nta burira.

symptoms_en: Dull yellowing and complete wilting of leaves, which hang down around the stem.
Male bud shrivels, blackens, and leaks a yellowish bacterial fluid when cut.
Banana fruits ripen prematurely and unevenly, showing internal brown rot.
symptoms_rw: Amababi agenda ahinduka umuhondo guhera hasi agana hejuru hanyuma igihingwa cyose kikuma.
Umutiriko w'ibitoki urabora kandi ugatunguka amazi anuka nabi cyane.
Ibitoki bikase bisohora amazi y'umweru ameze nk'amashyira mu mizi (bacterial ooze).
diseases.cause_en: The bacterium Xanthomonas vasicola pv. musacearum, highly contagious via insects and dirty tools.
diseases.cause_rw: Bagiteri Xanthomonas vasicola pv. musacearum, indwara ikwirakwizwa n'imvura n'imashini cyangwa ibikoresho bidapfuye.

chemical_en: No systemic chemical cure is available for BXW.
Clean surrounding plant tools using chemical disinfectants (bleach).
chemical_rw: Nta muti wemewe uhamye urwanya bagiteri mu bitoki.
Gutera imiti irimo Copper hydroxide bishobora gukumira ibindi bihingwa bitanduye.
organic_en: Destabilize the whole mat immediately: uproot, chop, and cover it to rot away.
Remove the male bud using a forked stick (not a knife) right after the last bunch forms.
organic_rw: Kurandura no gutwika ibitoki arwaye kure y'umurima.
Isuku ikomeye y'ibikoresho byose ukoresha mu buhinzi.

prevention_en: Sow clean tissue-culture suckers.
Enforce strict tool disinfection protocols on the farm.
prevention_rw: Gukoresha imbuto zizewe kandi zasukuwe mu mazi ashyushye.
Kusimburanya ibihingwa mu murima nibura mu myaka 3.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Bleach solutions used for disinfecting tools are corrosive; avoid direct contact with skin and eyes.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Copper compounds ni ubumara bw'amazi; wirinda ko umuti ugwa mu masomo cyangwa mu masoko y'amazi.

symptoms_en: Leaves are large, clean, dark-green, and climb vigorously on trellises.
Fruits are smooth, shiny, and purple or yellow according to variety.
No woody bumps or internal dry patches.

Nta rubobi cyangwa ifu y'umweru iri ku mababi.

Irrigate base gently using drip systems.
organic_rw: Komeza gukoresha ifumbire y'imborera ishyitse.
Kuhira amazi mu mizi ukoresha uburyo bwa drip irrigation.

Practice deep crop rotation.
prevention_rw: Isaso isukuye munsi y'igihingwa.
Gusimburanya ibihingwa.

symptoms_en: Fruits are small, distorted, and develop a thick woody rind with little pulp.
Leaves show severe chlorotic mottling, crinkling, and distortion.
Vines are severely stunted and productivity collapses.

Amababi aruma, agakanyarara hanyuma akayunguruka vuba.
Ibihingwa bigwingira kandi zikagabanya umusaruro cyane.

Spray systemic insecticides to control aphid vectors (Imidacloprid).

Kugabanya ikwirakwira rishobora gukorwa no gutera imiti irimo Copper Compounds.
organic_en: Uproot and safely burn all infected vines immediately.
Sanitize pruning tools with bleach or alcohol after working on each plant.
organic_rw: Kurandura no gutwika cyangwa gufukira kure cyane ibihingwa byarwaye.
Kuzamura PH y'ubutaka ukoresha ishwara y'ubuhinzi.

Establish new passion fruit orchards away from older, diseased fields.

Gusimburanya ibihingwa mu umurima.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Avoid chemical spraying when pollinators (carpenter bees) are active in daytime hours.

Imbuto za papayi zirashinyitse kandi nta mabara y'ikigina.
Nta rubobi cyangwa ifu y'umweru iri ku mababi.

Ibihingwa bigwingira kandi zikagabanya umusaruro.

Spray systemic insecticides to control aphid vector populations (Imidacloprid).

organic_en: Uproot and burn heavily infected trees immediately.
Intercrop with tall barrier plants (like maize or sorghum) to deter aphids.

Kuzamura PH y'ubutaka ukoresha ishwara y'ubuhinzi.

prevention_rw: Gukoresha ingemwe zizewe zitanduye.

Imbuto z'inkeri zirabora kandi ugatunguka amazi.

organic_en: Spray baking soda solution or organic neem oil extract formulations.

organic_en: Prune out infected twigs and burn them immediately.
Sanitize pruning tools with bleach or alcohol between trees.
organic_rw: Gukura amababi yafashwe ukayatwika cyangwa ukayafukira kure.
Isuku y'umurima n'ibikoresho.

prevention_en: Plant only certified canker-free citrus seedlings.
Establish windbreaks around the orchard to reduce rain-splash spread.
prevention_rw: Gukoresha imbuto zizewe zidafite uburwayi.
Gusimburanya ibihingwa mu murima buri myaka 3.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Copper chemicals are toxic to aquatic ecosystems; prevent runoff into drainage channels.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Copper compounds ni ubumara; wirinda ko umuti ugwa mu masomo cyangwa mu masoko y'amazi.

symptoms_en: Erect, solid leaves of a deep bluish-green color.
Bulb swelling naturally in soil with a clean surface.
No signs of rust pustules or purple blotches.

Umutiriko wa tungurusumu urimo kwipfuka neza kandi nta bimera by'umukara birimo.
Nta myenge y'udukoko cyangwa uduheri turwaza igihingwa.

diseases.cause_rw: Isuku y'umurima n'ifumbire ihagije y'imborera ishyitse.

chemical_en: No chemical treatment required.
Scout weekly for rust or purple blotch spots.

organic_en: Ensure deep, light, aerated soil bed.
Irrigate sparingly to avoid fungal multiplication.

Bungabunga ibidukikije ukura ibyatsi ku nkengero.

Control excessive moisture levels.
prevention_rw: Isuku rusange y'umurima n'ibikoresho.

symptoms_en: Small, reddish-orange powdery pustules scattered on leaves.
Leaves turn yellow, dry up, and die prematurely.
Severe infections result in stunted bulbs and poor yields.
symptoms_rw: Uduheri duto tw'ibara ry'umuringa (oranje/ikigina) twuzuye ku mababi cyane cyane munsi yayo.
Utu duheri iyo udukozeho, dusiga ifu y'ikigina ku ntoki.
Amababi ahinduka umuhondo, akagana hasi hanyuma agapfa vuba.
diseases.cause_en: The fungus Puccinia allii, active in cool, damp weather with high humidity.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye Puccinia allii wandira cyane mu bihe by'ubuhehere n'ubushyuhe bukabije.

chemical_en: Apply systemic fungicides containing Tebuconazole or protective Mancozeb.
Begin spraying at first sign of lower leaf pustules.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe urwanya imihumye urimo Tebuconazole cyangwa Mancozeb.
Gutera ku mababi yose guhera igihe ubona utubanza twa mbere.
organic_en: Spray copper-based organic formulations or baking soda-soap mixtures.
Uproot and burn heavily infected plants immediately.
organic_rw: Gutera amazi avanze n'isabune ikozwe mu bimera n'ifu y'ivu ry'amakara.
Kurandura no gutwika amababi yafashwe kugira ngo uburwayi butaguka.

prevention_en: Avoid high plant densities to optimize airflow inside rows.
Select rust-resistant garlic cultivars.
prevention_rw: Kwirinda gutera tungurusumu mu buryo bucucitse.
Kukoresha imbuto zizewe imbalances n'ubudahangarwa.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Never spray chemicals onto wet leaves. Respect pre-harvest intervals strictly.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Imiti ya simikiza igomba guterwa nyuma y'uko amazi y'ikime yakutse ku mababi.

symptoms_en: Lush, dark-green stalks and leaves, standing tall.
Stalks are crisp, solid, and free of any spots or lesions.
Roots are clean, well-developed, and anchoring properly.
symptoms_rw: Amababi meza akeye agororotse neza.
Umutiriko wa seleri urimo kwipfuka neza kandi nta bimera by'umukara birimo.
Nta myenge y'udukoko cyangwa uduheri turwaza igihingwa.
diseases.cause_en: Optimal soil moisture, proper spacing, and base drip irrigation.
diseases.cause_rw: Isuku y'umurima n'ifumbire ihagije y'imborera ishyitse.

Inspect regularly for early or late blight.

Komeza ugenzure ibyatsi bibi n'udukoko ku mababi.
organic_en: Add matured organic compost regularly.
Water base gently avoiding overhead spray.
organic_rw: Komeza kuhira amazi mu mizi ariko utazana ubuhehere bukabije.
Bungabunga ibidukikije ukura ibyatsi ku nkengero.

prevention_en: Maintain crop rotation.
Keep beds clean and weed-free.
prevention_rw: Isuku rusange y'umurima n'ibikoresho.

symptoms_en: Small chlorotic spots on leaves, turning dark-brown with black dots.
Lesions can girdle stalks, causing them to rot and collapse.
Foliage rots and disintegrates rapidly.

Urubobi rw'imvi cyangwa rw'umuhengeri munsi y'ababi iyo hari ubuhehere.
Amababi agenda avunika ahuye n'umuyaga hanyuma akabora vuba.
diseases.cause_en: The fungus Septoria apiicola, highly active in wet, cool climates.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye Septoria apiicola ukunda ubuhehere bukabije n'imbeho.

chemical_en: Apply protective copper-based formulations or systemic fungicides.
Spray thoroughly covering both leaf surfaces.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe urwanya imihumye urimo Metalaxyl cyangwa Copper-based fungicides.
Gutera ku mababi yose guhera igihe ubona utubanza twa mbere.
organic_en: Spray baking soda and neem oil solution.
Destroy heavily diseased plants immediately.
organic_rw: Gutera amazi arimo baking soda na neem oil.
Kurandura no gutwika ibihingwa byafashwe.

prevention_en: Avoid overhead evening watering.
Space celery plants properly to optimize ventilation.
prevention_rw: Kwirinda kuhira uminjira amazi ku mababi mu mugoroba.
Gusiga intera ihagije hagati y'ibihingwa ngo umuyaga utambuke neza.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Strictly follow personal safety guidelines when applying chemicals.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Wambare ibikoresho bikurinda byose igihe utera umuti, kandi wirinde gukoresha imiti yarengeje igihe.

symptoms_en: Large, lobed leaves of a solid green color, standing tall.
Zucchinis are firm, straight, and show clean smooth skin.
No powdery or downy growths on any vines.
symptoms_rw: Amababi manini atoshye y'icyatsi kibisi kiboneye.
Imbuto za courgette zirashinyitse kandi nta mabara y'ikigina.
Nta rubobi cyangwa ifu y'umweru iri ku mababi.
diseases.cause_en: Clean field conditions, stable soil moisture, and drip watering.
diseases.cause_rw: Isuku y'umurima n'ubuhehere buhuye neza mu mizi.

chemical_en: No chemical treatment required.
Scout leaves for powdery mildew regularly.
chemical_rw: Nta muti ukenewe.
Komeza gukurikirana imikurire.
organic_en: Apply rich compost manure to soil bases.
Irrigate roots directly using drip pipes.
organic_rw: Komeza gukoresha ifumbire y'imborera ishyitse.
Kuhira amazi mu mizi ukoresha uburyo bwa drip irrigation.

prevention_en: Use clean mulch beneath the vines.
Practice deep crop rotation.
prevention_rw: Isaso isukuye munsi y'igihingwa.
Gusimburanya ibihingwa.
diseases.safety_warning_en: No synthetic chemical safety warnings are applicable for healthy zucchinis.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Nta burira rusange.

symptoms_en: White powdery spots spreading across leaf surfaces, stems, and fruits.
Leaves turn yellow, become brittle, and drop off prematurely.
Fruit size is reduced and quality degrades.
symptoms_rw: Urubobi rw'umweru runyanyagiye ku mababi, ku ruti n'imbuto nka kime.
Amababi ahinduka umuhondo, agapfunyika hanyuma akayunguruka.
Imbuto zigwingira kandi zikagabanya uburyohe.
diseases.cause_en: The fungus Podosphaera xanthii, spreading in dry, warm climates following rains.
diseases.cause_rw: Umuhumye Podosphaera xanthii wandira mu gihe cy'ubushyuhe bukabije bukurikira igihe cy'imvura.

chemical_en: Apply Sulphur-based fungicides or systemic options like Triadimefon.
Spray during evening hours to avoid sulphur sun scorch.
chemical_rw: Umuti wemewe urwanya imihumye urimo Sulphur cyangwa Triadimefon.
Gutera nimugoroba izuba ryarenze kuko Sulphur ishobora kurandura amababi ku zuba.
organic_en: Spray baking soda (5g per liter) mixed with mild liquid soap.
Prune to increase light exposure within foliage.
organic_rw: Gutera baking soda (gramu 5 ku litiro y'amazi) ivanze n'isabune y'amazi yoroheje.
Kuzamura umucyo ugera ku gihingwa.

prevention_en: Thoroughly prune dense crop areas.
Plant powdery mildew-resistant zucchini seed cultivars.
prevention_rw: Gukopenyura amashami n'ababi bicucitse cyane.
Gukoresha imbuto zihanganira ifu y'umweru.
diseases.safety_warning_en: Wear appropriate protective equipment during application. Sulphur irritates eyes.
diseases.safety_warning_rw: Sulphur ishobora kwangiza mu maso; wambare ibikoresho by'umutekano bikurinda igihe cyo gutera.
